caption: Two 45-man Spearmen phalanxes grind head-on for the whole clip. Each is 9 files wide and only 5 ranks deep -- shallower than a spear's own 6-rank reach depth -- which is exactly the case that used to put EVERY soldier in SoldierBodies' engaged tier and leave no unengaged bulk to hold the formation's shape, so rank and file order churned indefinitely and men visibly slid sideways past their neighbours mid-melee. The body-dynamics tier is now scoped to bodily CONTACT depth (one rank at the standard rank pitch) instead of weapon reach, so only the men actually being shoved get the engaged treatment; the amber engaged-soldier highlight shows the tier sitting on the contact rank rather than covering both blocks end to end, and the ranks behind it dress and hold their files through the grind. Melee resolution is untouched -- all six ranks of spears still strike.
